# Campaign query parameters can leave Portal Learning blank

## Context

The Portal Learning controller selects a deck from `location.search` before it loads the tree. Campaign links can include query parameters alongside the Learn route.

## The Problem

At `78013b10fc`, calling `getSearchParams` with `?utm_content=part=a`, `?utm_content=%22release%22`, or `?utm_source` throws `SyntaxError`. The controller’s promise never sets `deck`, so the provider never selects the content path and the Learning tree does not load.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: `apps/portal/view/learn/MainContainerController.mjs` uses `getSearchParams(data).deck || 'learnneo'` to keep the default deck available when the query lacks an explicit deck. `apps/portal/Util.mjs` owns the query parsing, and the Learning state provider owns deck selection.

## The Fix

Parse the browser query string with `URLSearchParams` and return its entries as an object. Preserve the current last-value behavior for repeated keys. Keep the regression in the existing Portal utility spec.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Bare tracking parameters, embedded equals signs and encoded quotation marks parse without throwing. A query without a deck continues to select the default Learn deck.
- [ ] Explicit decks still parse, repeated deck values select the last value, and empty or null input returns an empty object.
- [ ] The focused Portal utility and route-helper specs pass.

## Out of Scope

Content, navigation layout, and SEO metadata.
